dedupe_keys.name: areali serviti da rete di teleriscaldamento

description: Areali serviti da rete di teleriscaldamento is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geoserver-ucvv.055055.it. Inter-municipal Structural Plan of the Municipalities of Pontassieve, Londa, Pelago, Rufina and San Godenzo. Areas served by district heating network. Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "Areas served by district heating network" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Comune di Londa, PSI, geodata, Unione di Comuni Valdarno e Valdisieve, Comune di San Godenzo, c_h937. The listing shows 2 download or service links in WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://inspire.ec.europa.eu/metadata-codelist/ConditionsApplyingToAccessAndUse/noConditionsApply). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
